title: A Wreck for the Horizon
author: Wendell Sterling
blurb: Noor Joubert, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
